Don't talk too loud. Don't get too excited. Don't stim. Don't rock. Don't let your eyes wander. Don't cover your ears or eyes. Don't flinch. Don't fidget. Don't touch people. Don't open up. Don't talk about yourself. Don't act weird. Don't be annoying. That's the mask.

I'm angry because so many people assume I'm disabled because I'm fat and offer unwanted advice about how to lose the weight even when they have no idea how to even pronounce the name of my disability. #DisabilityAnger
I'm angry because every fucking week I see another hot take think piece on why accessibility tools are really just lazy shortcuts. #DisabilityAnger
I'm angry because every goddamn job I see hiring requires me to stand for long periods of time even if the job doesn't logistically require it. #DisabilityAnger
Why am I angry? I'm angry because I have to walk with a cane and my state says I'm not old enough to be disabled. #DisabilityAnger
